rv.q: It might not be enough for this show.
Mac's tour-de-fierce performance is reason enough to plan a visit to Orlando.
With intentional casting and whimsical performances, this production will be a treat for audiences.
But the production’s push-and-pull ultimately frustrates.

cn.t: Sarah Ruhl's adaptation of Virginia Woolf's time-traveling tale enchants critics, with Taylor Mac's androgynous performance as the genderfluid aristocrat earning particular praise for bringing jubilant iconoclasm to this riotous revival.
